---
title: "Scenarios"
---

The scenarios are designed for in-person practice with the Zoll. Use the public slides for learner review; facilitator-specific prompts belong in the instructor guide.

::: {.scenario-grid}
::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 1

Pulseless patient with severe metabolic derangements. Focus: asystole versus fine VF and the less-bad error when uncertain.

[Open case](slides/case_1.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 2

Pulseless VF/VT physiology with post-ROSC ECG decision-making. Focus: first shock and cause search.

[Open case](slides/case_2.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 3

Polymorphic VT/TdP after QT-prolonging medications. Focus: pulseless defibrillation versus unstable cardioversion versus stable magnesium.

[Open case](slides/case_3.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 4

Unstable tachycardia during an RRT. Focus: rhythm interpretation, adenosine context, and escalation.

[Open case](slides/case_4.html)
:::

::: {.scenario-card}
### Case 5

Bradycardia with hypotension and confusion. Focus: complete heart block, pacing pads, and transcutaneous pacing setup.

[Open case](slides/case_5.html)
:::
:::

::: {.callout-note}
No public sixth-case source exists in the current 2026 site. Add one only if a complete scenario is ready for learners.
:::
